about: Fortnite build pieces (build mode, key G). The grid (1.2.0): lines every match.buildTile blocks across and every match.buildHeight blocks up (a storey's line is one block under where you stand), and every piece sits ON them, as Fortnite's do. slot: the number key that picks the piece while building (1-3). wall: on the line on the side of your tile you face, from your storey's line to the next one up (the same wall from either side). floor: your storey's line, edge to edge, on the tile in front of you (or under you when looking down). ramp: the tile in front, from its near line at your storey to its far line a storey up. On a ramp rising the way you face you count as at its top: a ramp or a floor ahead carries on up from it, and a wall goes on the far line of the tile in front, a storey up (Fortnite's ramp rush). Pieces meeting on a line share those blocks; a shared block stays while any piece has it. cost: materials of the selected kind per piece. Left mouse places, right mouse switches Wood / Brick / Metal. Pieces only fill air (and grass/flowers); guns damage them (materials.pieceHealth); the pickaxe breaks a whole piece. All built pieces disappear when the match ends.
